metaDescription: Enable subscription products in Squarespace with recurring billing, checkout options, and subscriber management for your store.
intro: If you're running a membership site, subscription box, or recurring digital content, Squarespace lets you enable and manage subscriptions directly through your store's commerce settings. This guide covers turning on subscription products, setting billing intervals, and managing subscribers.

steps.heading: Access Commerce Settings
steps.body: Log in to Squarespace and open your site's Commerce settings, where subscription options live alongside your other store configurations.

steps.heading: Enable subscription products
steps.body: Turn on the subscription product type so you can offer recurring items instead of, or alongside, one-time purchases.

steps.heading: Set pricing and billing intervals
steps.body: Choose how often customers are billed — such as monthly or annually — and set the price for each billing cycle.

steps.heading: Configure checkout and payment options
steps.body: Review your checkout settings to make sure recurring payments process correctly for subscribers.

steps.heading: Manage subscribers and renewals
steps.body: Use the subscriber management tools to track active subscriptions, handle renewals, and monitor customer retention.

faq.question: What kinds of businesses can use Squarespace subscriptions?
faq.answer: It works for eCommerce stores, service-based businesses, and content creators looking to generate recurring revenue.

faq.question: Can I set different billing intervals for different products?
faq.answer: Yes, you can configure pricing and billing intervals per subscription product to match what each offer requires.

faq.question: How do I manage subscribers after they sign up?
faq.answer: Squarespace's subscriber management tools let you track active subscriptions and handle renewals from your dashboard.

faq.question: Can I automate emails for subscribers?
faq.answer: Yes, automating emails is one of the ways to keep subscribers informed and improve retention over time.
